# {{ site.title }} — {{ site.author }}

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines | strip }}

Personal blog of {{ site.author }}, written and maintained since 2008. Miles is
an engineering leader in Indianapolis, Indiana. He founded IndyHackers, a
501(c)(3) supporting the Indiana tech community, and organizes the Indianapolis
Ruby Brigade.

The archive spans roughly two decades and clusters into a few subjects:

- **Software engineering** — Ruby, Rails, DataMapper, Emacs, Vim, Git, and the
  day-to-day mechanics of writing code. Densest in the 2008–2011 posts.
- **Engineering leadership** — management reading, growing engineers, and
  running teams. Mostly 2019 onward.
- **Books** — yearly reading recaps and recommendations.
- **Tabletop games and conventions** — Gen Con recaps, RPG design, running
  games.
- **Personal essays** — for example [My Racism]({{ "/my-racism" | absolute_url }}),
  on unexamined racism in everyday behaviour.

Note on dates: posts are historical and are not revised after publication.
A 2010 post about Rails describes Rails as it was in 2010.

## Start here

- [About Miles Z. Sterrett]({{ "/about" | absolute_url }}): Biography, hobbies, community work, and how to get in touch.

## Reference documentation

Practical guides Miles maintains for the volunteer sound crew at Northview
Theater. Self-contained and useful to anyone running sound for community or
school theater.
